summary.text: Mark Matthiesen is a Republican state representative who has represented Missouri House of Representatives District 107 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. A real estate agent with a hospitality-industry background, he lives in O'Fallon, Missouri.

paragraphs.text: Matthiesen was born in Fayetteville, Arkansas, lives in O'Fallon, Missouri, and graduated from Washington High School in 1994.
He earned an associate degree in accounting from Florida State College at Jacksonville in 1999 and a bachelor's degree in hospitality management from Southwest Missouri State University in 2005.

His career experience includes working as a licensed real estate agent at Coldwell Banker and Realty ONE Group, regional manager of the Qdoba Restaurant Corporation, general manager of McAlister's Deli, floor supervisor at the Ameristar Casino Resort, and chief financial officer at STL Regional Development Group.

For the 2025-2026 session, he was assigned to the Consent and House Procedure Committee, the House General Laws Committee, the House Ways and Means Committee, and the Insurance Committee, where he was vice chair.

In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, Matthiesen described himself as a Christian, husband and father who had been a leader in the hospitality industry for over 20 years, and said he was passionate about education.
